fade.description: Abiṭun, aberkan d ačinaw n uxeddim, isekkilen imeqqranen i tezrawt n usenfel.

ottoman.description: Nnḥas, azegzaw n yill d isekkilen yettwagezmen: ccḥef n zik n uḥeffaf n Istanbul.

nord.description: Aɣeryan n udɣaɣ, ardwaz d tira n ugafa: aḥareb n yergazen war awal d ameẓyan.

flash.description: Aberkan n lmidad, azeggaɣ d awraɣ, tira tagutit n tferkiwin n tecraḍ.

enseigne.description: Azegzaw, azeggaɣ d amellal n zzlij, tira yettwasnen s snat n tutlayin n uḥeffaf n tɣemmert n zznqa.

ocre.description: Akal yettwasewwen, awraɣ d keṭṭan, tazrawt taḥmayant i tcuccay d ucebbub agaman.

wax.description: Azeggaɣ, awraɣ d azegzaw, initen iǧehden n yiceṭṭiḍen wax n Lagos d Abidjan.

harlem.description: Ini n ubercan n yiḍ, ddheb d isekkilen Art déco: lɛali n yisaluniyen n Harlem deg tallit n jazz.

labo.description: Amellal, azegzaw n yill d xuxx, zeddig am lmexber: tasledt d uḥareb n tcuccay.

tresses.description: Abercan, zzeεfran d ukeryis yettwaḍefren, tazrawt anda yal taḍefrit d unuɣ.

sanctuaire.description: Tamemmust, talaxt d lkaɣeḍ amagan, amkan ihedden i wakken ad tebduḍ locs-ik u ad ten-tḥerzeḍ.

zenith.description: Azegzaw n yill aqerḍas, ddheb d učinaw iceεlen: asalun afro n uzekka s talɣiwin yeččuren.

sahel.description: Nnila yettwasebɣen s ufus d yijdi uḥmay, asefses n tlemmast tameqqrant n Sahel.

caraibes.description: Azegzaw n lfirus, lmerǧan d mangu, asalun yeččuren d lferḥ s ureḥ n unebdu n tegzirin.

onyx.description: Aberkan amsas d yiwen n yifili n ddheb, isekkilen imeqqranen yemgarraden, ur nelli ara d ayen-nniḍen.

seoul.description: Axuxi n uyefki, lavand d tiɣemmar timdewrin: asturyu n iccer leqqaqen am Seoul, tugniwin d nutenti i d asfaylu.

francaise.description: Ini n yiles, amellal d Bodoni leqqaqen: lɛeqel n manikur tafransist, ssuma deg tgejda am tkarḍa.

chrome.description: Aɣiɣdi n wuzzal d grafit, tugniwin s ubrik d umellal deg ukatar n uzzal, i nail art chrome.

regard.description: Aberkan d uxuxi n tebrurt, ajerriḍ uzlig: bar n yeccifen d tmiwin, tamazzult deg ugensu.

cerise.description: Azeggaɣ n tadeffuyt ɣef ugilal n krim, takarḍa retro i manikur aklasiki d lvirni ifazen.

starlette.description: Axuxi n lḥelwa, azegzaw n llufan d isekkilen ibuzzaḍ: nail art Y2K, isem n usturyu yettɛeddi.

verveine.description: Azegzaw n yifer, akettan d tesfift n yemɣan: nail spa n leɛtab agamani d yifassen yesteɛfan.

cabine.description: Amellal n tsibitar, azegzaw n wuzzal d imḍanen mono: asebter zeddigen d tuṭṭfa n wakud deg ugdil akk.

miami.description: Turkwaz, axuxi n lxux d ijerriḍen n uɣelluy n tafukt, isekkilen imdewren i usturyu n iccer.

memphis.description: Kobalt, awraɣ d turkwaz, tiɣemmar tiqedḥin d isekkilen iberkanen: asalun grafik s ṛṛuḥ n Memphis.

riso.description: Azegzaw d uxuxi n fluo ɣef lkaɣeḍ, tugniwin s sin n yiniten: asalun am fanzine yettwasiggzen.

menthe.description: Axuxi n tejjujt d uzegzaw n nɛenaɛ, talɣiwin timdewrin i usalun ilemẓi yettḍeṣṣan.

bulle.description: Azeggaɣ, awraɣ d tenqiḍin, isekkilen n BD i usalun yeččuren d tazmert.

arcade.description: Azegzaw n waman, magenta d isekkilen imdewren: asalun n tḥanut tameqrant n 90, isem s tibddi.

marelle.description: Azegzaw n igenni, awraɣ leqqaqen d talɣiwin timdewrin: asalun n twacult anda meẓẓiyen d imeqqranen ttwaqeblen.

campus.description: Aberkan, amellal d uzegzaw n llim, ssuma tettwaɣra s yiwet n tmuɣli, tuṭṭfa n wakud seg uqerru n usebter.

fresque.description: Abiṭun, awraɣ n lɛelama d isekkilen imeqqranen: asalun n taddart yettwasebɣen am uɣrab n street art.

citronnade.description: Azegzaw n ugaraw ilemmasen d uwraɣ n llim, tugna deg ukatar am uɣmis n ssuq n unebdu.

apothicaire.description: Ajaj n lɛenber, lkaɣeḍ d isekkilen Caslon: tabdart n lɛinaya am tbiṭaqt n tqerɛet.

riad.description: Tadelakt, akal yeɣlin d uzegzaw n zellij: tawlaft deg ukatar am lḥara n riyad.

marbre.description: Rrxam s yizuran, nnḥas d isekkilen irumanen: taxxamt teḥman n lḥemmam aṭerki, s yini yeṣfan.

onsen.description: Lkaɣeḍ washi, smaq d lerz: isem yettwaru s ubeddu, talwit n usired n Japun.

sauna.description: Tafat n wedfel, aɣebbar n tamda d usɣar afaw: tafat n sauna n ugafa.

dune.description: Ijdi, azru azeggaɣ d igenni n tmeddit: spa n Sahra s tewlafin timeqqranin, yeḥman, yessehdan.

thermes.description: Amellal d uzegzaw n waman yeḥman: lɛinaya tettwaḥjaz seg ugdil amezwaru, am deg tnezduɣt n tḥemmamt.

veillee.description: Tafat n teftilt ɣef uqahwi n yiḍ: spa n tmeddit, yeṣṣefḍen, anda isem n wemkan yeṭṭef akk asayes.

derma.description: Amellal n uklinik, yiwen n uzeggaɣ d uẓeṭṭa uḥdiq: tiseddi n tnezduɣt n tmussni n yilem.

rosee.description: Axuxi n tjeǧǧigt, azegzaw n usigna d talɣiwin leqqaqen: ilem n ujaj n leɛwayed n Kurya.

officine.description: Azegzaw n lfarmasi, amellal yeṣfan d isekkilen n tbiṭaqt: tansa d lɛinaya ɣer ufus, am deg lfarmasi.

champagne.description: Aberkan iceɛɛlen d ccampanya, Didot ameqqran: taḥanut n lɛinaya n uɣlay am usebter n tɣamsa.

protocole.description: Amellal n laboratwar d uzegzaw chartreuse: lɛinaya yettwasbedden am yiprutukulen, ssuma d tanzagt ɣef yiwen yizirig.

quartz.description: Axuxi n kwartz d tafat n lɣebra ddaw taddart leqqaqen, i wammas n ucebbaḥ leqqaqen.

kraft.description: Lkaɣeḍ kraft, azegzaw n yifer d isekkilen n tbiṭaqt: akusmitik agamawan s ufus, am uɣmis n lḥiṭ.

perle.description: Aberquq aḥercaw d umellal n tewsart, isem meqqer am ɣef tbewwaṭ n lǧuher: lɛinaya mgal tewser n uɣlay.

lagune.description: Azegzaw n lebḥer aḥercaw d nneɛneɛ afaw, isem n wammas yettḥerriken: med-spa n wass-a.

studio.description: Aceɛlal, yeẓɣel, s uččinawi n Saloneo i usalun n yal ameẓlu i d-yettawin srid ɣer uḥeǧǧez.

atelier.description: Aɣanib n tɣamsa: isem n usalun s umeqqran am uɣerraf, imeẓla am wumuɣ n tqahwa.

hammam.description: Azegzaw aḥercaw, ijdi d nnḥas, taddart tamuṛit i lḥemmam d spa.

barber.description: Aberkan n ufeḥmi, nnḥas awraɣ d yisekkilen yettwaẓemmen: talwiḥt n uḥeffaf n taddart.

onglerie.description: Axuxi d ubenfsaǧ, tibbucin n yiniten am tqerɛiwin n ṣṣbiɣa, i yisalunen n yiccer.

mariee.description: Amellal n ujeǧǧig, ini n cambanya d uwraɣ-axuxi, tallunt d tafat i tslit d uzewwaq.

institut.description: Yeṣfa, yessehdan, azegzaw n uzenzu d tira tusdidt i wammas n ucebbaḥ.

karakou.description: Amxemli azeggaɣ d lxiḍ n wureɣ, tawlaft deg ukatar n wureɣ: tafrara n lkaraku d ccedda i tislit n zik.

blanc.description: Amellal d uɣlay n tejjujt, azamul d tallunt tameqqrant: tislit n tura, fessusen.

roseraie.description: Axuxi aqbur d uzegzaw n ssalmiya s yiri n yemɣan: tameɣra n leḥmala deg urti.

henne.description: Aqehwi n lḥenni d zzeɛfran, tinqiḍin timeẓyanin am weqcic yettwasunnen s ufus, i yiḍ n lḥenni.

gala.description: Aberkan yettfeǧǧiǧen d lɛaj, tawlaft am di sinima d isekkilen imeqqranen: tameddit n gala.

boheme.description: Ijdi, akal azeggaɣ d lkettan, talɣiwin leqqaqen d tewlafin teḥman i tmeɣra tabuhimit ɣef yiri n yilel.

sultane.description: Azegzaw n zzmerred, aureɣ d uzeggaɣ n Iznik, s tbeqqa n teqwas: tislit n tgeldit s ssifa tutmanit.

taqendurt.description: Awraɣ, azeggaɣ d uzegzaw ɣef umellal, s tɛeṣṣabin am tid n tqendurt taqbaylit, i tmeɣriwin n Tmurt n Leqbayel.

age-dor.description: Lɛaj, aberkan d ccampanya, isekkilen Art déco s ubeddi: tafrara n yitran imeqqranen n sinima.

casbah.description: Lǧir amellal d uzegzaw n tewwura, taqwest d tbeqqa n teqwas: Lqasba n Lezzayer s ttawil fessusen.

kabylie.description: Aberkan, lfeṭṭa d lmerǧan, s teɣmar yettwagezmen am ṣṣiɣa n At Yenni.

tlemcen.description: Awraɣ n wakal, azegzaw n zzlayej d zzlayej: tafrara tandalusit n Tlemsan i usalun n lɛada.

constantine.description: Adɣaɣ aɣlay d nnḥas, izirigen jebden am yimrawen n leqnaṭer n Qsenṭina.

tassili.description: Ijdi n wureɣ d uzeggaɣ n tira ɣef yedɣaɣen: Ṣṣeḥra n Tassili.

oran.description: Azegzaw n yilel d uwraɣ n yiṭij, asekles seg tazwara: Wehran, n tura u n yilel agrakal.

mzab.description: Azegzaw n yigenni, axuxi d nnaɛnaɛ, tamuzayikt n tewlafin: ixxamen s yini leqqaqen n Mzab.

timgad.description: Adɣaɣ aqurar d uzegzaw n rrend, isekkilen irumaniyen yettwagezmen: Timgad n zik.

alger-blanche.description: Udmawen n lkrim d wuzzal yettwaxedmen, tawlaft am ṭṭaq: Lezzayer tamellalt d iberdan-is imeqqranen.

medina.description: Anili, zzeɛfran d zzlayej: i tkerrimt n Lqasba, i usalun yeṭṭfen deg wagemmay-is.

noir.description: Aberkan aḥercaw d wureɣ, tarbaɛt deg uẓɣer: asalun n uɣlay.

nordique.description: Asɣar aceɛlal, azegzaw n tqiqact d tallunt tameqqrant: asalun askandinavi, iḥedden yerna d uẓrif.

encre.description: Amellal yeṣfan, aberkan n lmidad d twelt tazeggaɣt: astudyu n ugzam afessas am win n Tokyo.

pigment.description: Azegzaw, ajeǧǧig d uwraɣ-axuxi: abar n yini n London anida isem yettɛeddi s umeqqran.

terrazzo.description: Ajewz, terrazzo d tafat tazɣalt: asalun n Milano, tugniwin deg yikadranen am tɣamsa n tẓuri n lebni.

balayage.description: Ijdi aceɛlal, talaxt d ugfuf n yilel: astudyu n balayage n Kalifornya, s tmuɣli tameqqrant am usaru n unebdu.

galerie.description: Iɣerban imellalen d yiwen n uzegzaw n yilel: asalun am tesqamut n tẓuri, imeẓla ttwasersen deg uẓeṭṭa.

beton.description: Béton, isekkilen imeqqranen iberkanen d uẓeṭṭa n lebni: loft anida tḥeǧǧzeḍ akken kan ara tawḍeḍ.

vendome.description: Amellal n ujeǧǧig d uberkan, isekkilen irqaqen: axxam n ucebbub n Paris, aḥerfi yerna d aɣlay.

deco.description: Aberkan d wureɣ, tugna deg ukadri n wureɣ: asalun Art déco, ssuma-s tettwaru s tgejda.

haussmann.description: Akrim d urkan n zinc: axxam ameqqran n Haussmann yuɣalen d asalun, s ttwaqi-ines imeqqranen.

velours.description: Lmexmel n bordeaux d yini n cambanya: acebbub n couture n Ṭelyan, am tɣamsa n lmuda.

greige.description: Greige, adɣaɣ d tilɣa leqqaqen: aɣlay atrar s yiwen yini, war awal yugaren.

salon-prive.description: Azegzaw ubreɣ d nnḥas awraɣ, tansa si tazwara: asalun uslig anida tettaseḍ s timlilit.

couverture.description: Isekkilen iberkanen ɣef umellal d uzeggaɣ n tcenḍuct: asalun ɣef uqerru n tɣamsa, isem-is d azwel ameqqran.

riviera.description: Cambanya, anili d yizirigen n teqjirt n yilel: asalun n Riviera, d aẓrif yerna d iṭij.

laque.description: Lkaɣeḍ washi, laque urushi d tsusmi: aɣlay n Japun deg uḥezzeb, umuɣ awezzlan yettwafernen.

epure.description: Aberkan d umellal, ulac ayen ur nesɛi lmeɛna: taseddast tafessast akk deg tegrumma.

soleil.description: Ini n lmerǧan d uwraɣ n yiṭij: asalun n taddart, n twacult, yeqqabalen s tumert.

botanique.description: Ceṭṭiḥ, azemmur d talaxt: taseddast n tɣamsa i lɛinaya tagamawant.
